# Project GitHub Account Rule

For this repository (`DeepakKag12/gym_web`), use only the GitHub account `DeepakKag12` (`kagdeepak45@gmail.com`) for any suggested GitHub CLI commands, Git operations, repository access, and authentication-related actions.

Do not switch to, use, or publish through any other GitHub account for this project. Before account-sensitive operations, verify with `gh auth status` that `DeepakKag12` is the active account.

The user has final control over command execution. Never execute commands that mutate the local or remote repository. This includes file edits, dependency installs, commits, pushes, pull requests, merges, releases, branch changes, and GitHub CLI write commands. Provide each required command for the user to execute, followed by its meaning and purpose. Read-only inspection may be performed when necessary, but prefer giving the user the command when practical.
